Incident Type: VESSEL

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 38.861111, -76.493056 (Explicit)
Reported Spill Volume: 2000 gallon
Report DescriptionAMPLIFYING INFORMATION: - AT APPROXIMATELY 1215R / 1615Z ON 27 JULY 2024, MOTOR YACHT LOVE BUG BEGAN TAKING ON WATER IN THE WEST RIVER, APPROXIMATELY 9 NM SOUTH OF ANNAPOLIS, MD. - THE VESSEL PARTIALLY SANK ON ITS STARBOARD SIDE. - THERE WERE 05 PERSONS ON BOARD. 04 PERSONS ENTERED THE WATER AND WERE SAFELY RECOVERED BY GOOD SAMARITAN VESSELS. ALL CREWMEMBERS ARE SAFE WITH NO REPORTED INJURIES. - THE VESSEL HAS AN ESTIMATED 1,000-2,000 GAL OF DIESEL FUEL ONBOARD. - THERE IS NO REPORTED POLLUTION AND SOLVENT BOOM HAS BEEN PLACED AROUND THE VESSEL BY TOWBOATUS. - USCG STATION ANNAPOLIS IS ENFORCING A SAFETY ZONE AROUND THE VESSEL AND TOWBOATUS IS PREPARING A WRITTEN SALVAGE PLAN. - SALVAGE OPERATIONS ARE TENTATIVELY ANTICIPATED TO COMMENCE ON 29 JULY. - THERE ARE NO ANTICIPATED IMPACTS TO THE MARITIME TRANSPORTATION SYSTEM. - ESTIMATED DAMAGE IS $2,000,000 USD. THE VESSEL WAS OPERATING AS A RECREATIONAL VESSEL WITH A LICENSED MARINER AS THE MASTER. - THE STATE OF MARYLAND IS LEAD FOR THE INVESTIGATION WITH USCG PROVIDING ASSISTANCE. - USCG WILL PROVIDE NOTIFICATION TO NTSB DUE TO THE CLASSIFICATION AS A MAJOR MARINE CASUALTY.
